added: With Custom Figures on, a figure that comes with the app has Copy as your own figure in the Glossary: it opens the editor on a new figure of your own with its definition, beats, wording and parameters, which you change and save. The built-in figure is never changed, and the copy says what it was copied from.

`userFigureSeedFromMove` derives a new figure of the user's own from a shipped move: its parameters its wording uses (choices given choice ids of the user's own shape, "none" and "not stated" left out), its default beats, and its wording, always valid (#1023).
